entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold while I connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. You've reached VeloFit, my name is David. How can I help you today?
Hi... yes, um, I'm a bit lost. I have this jersey I bought, and I think I need to send it back, but I'm not really sure how it all works. The website was confusing.
I can certainly help you look into a return. To start, what specifically is the issue with the jersey? Is it a technical fault or a matter of preference?
Oh, a fault? No, no, nothing like that. It's just... it's the wrong size. It's really too tight, and I don't think I can wear it. I was hoping I could exchange it for a bigger one.
Okay, I completely understand. A good fit is essential. Let me just pull up your order details to check on the return eligibility. Do you have an order number I can use?
An order number? Oh, heavens. I wouldn't know where to find that. My emails are such a mess. Can't you just help me? My name is Susan Miller.

Not a problem at all, Susan. I can look you up with your name. One moment while I search our system... Okay, I see an order here for the 'Vento Pro Jersey' delivered on September 19th. That would make it 81 days ago. Is that the one?
81 days? Has it really been that long? Oh dear. See, I get so overwhelmed with this stuff. I was worried I was too late. Are you sure you can help?
Of course. And I have good news for you. I've just confirmed our policy, and for standard items like that jersey, VeloFit has a 90-day return window. You are well within the timeframe.
Oh, really? That's a huge relief! Thank you. So I can definitely do an exchange for a different size?

Absolutely. I am generating a pre-paid return shipping label and I'll email it to you right now. Just print it out, pack up the jersey, and you can drop it in the mail. Once we receive it, we'll ship out the next size up for you.
That sounds wonderful. You've made this so simple. Thank you so much, David.
You're very welcome, Susan. The email should be in your inbox now. Is there anything else I can do for you today?
It was my pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit and have a great day.
